data.revised_prompt:
Create a single 1536x1152 PNG sprite sheet for a 2D game damage attack FX animation. Use the supplied first reference image only for visual identity: royal blue dragon energy, cyan horn-crown glow, sharp white highlights, gold-and-white elite royal accents, jewel-like sparks, polished aquatic fantasy pixel-sprite style. Use the supplied layout guide only for layout understanding: 3 rows x 4 columns, equal invisible frame slots, centered with safe padding. Do NOT reproduce guide elements.

Canvas: exactly 1536x1152. 12 frames arranged 3 rows x 4 columns, each cell 384x384, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Background must be 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta everywhere including margins and between frames. No transparency needed in render but edges should be transparent-ready. No visible boxes, no grid lines, no borders, no labels, no text, no UI, no numbers, no letters, no watermarks. No cards, no poker faces, no suits, no J letters, no ranks. No full character body. Compact overlay FX only, fixed avatar combat effect scale. Each FX centered in its invisible cell with generous magenta margin, nothing touches or crosses cell edges. Keep same bounding box, same pixel scale, and same visual center across all frames.

Style: clean HD pixel-inspired game sprite FX, crisp readable silhouettes, saturated blue/cyan/white/gold palette, polished RPG battle damage effect. Hostile damage projectile and hit impact traveling from enemy avatar toward player. Not special ability activation, not card collection, not table-card vacuum.

Animation title: Dragon Prince Damage Verdict. A fast royal dragonfire damage strike: begins as a sharp crown-horn spark, condenses into a blue-white dragon fang projectile, slashes forward, hits player with piercing royal burst, fades into small cyan burn sparks.

Frame contents:
1. Tiny cyan crown-horn spark, hostile and sharp, no cards.
2. Spark stretches into a narrow blue-white fang of energy with two small gold accents.
3. Fang becomes a compact dragonfire bolt, angled forward, white-hot core.
4. Bolt grows faster and sharper, with short cyan tail flame, still centered.
5. First contact slash: diagonal blue-white cut mark with gold royal rim.
6. Impact build: compact starburst at center, cyan flame petals and gold shards.
7. Peak damage impact: brightest frame, piercing white core, jagged blue dragonfire burst, royal gold shock spikes.
8. Damage shock ring: circular cyan ring with sharp gold cracks, no cards.
9. Recoil flame: blue fire curls backward like a dragon tail, impact core dims.
10. Fragment fade: small cyan embers, gold splinters, thin white hit scars.
11. Residual damage mark: faint blue burn slash and tiny jewel sparks.
12. Loop-ready settle: almost empty, one small cyan spark and a fading gold glint.

Ensure the sheet clearly reads as a damage effect after card ability has already resolved: hostile projectile, impact, score-loss feeling. Detached sparks only tightly grouped near impact and inside each cell. No black background, no wide fullscreen blast.
